text: Ever say 'I should go outside'…
and then don't? Same.
Meet StrollCall.
Less planning. More walking.
Tell it what you want in one sentence,
like 'twenty minutes, quiet streets, coffee at the end.'
Type it, or just say it.
StrollCall plans a real walk from where you are,
and you're out the door.
Want company? Send one link.
Your friend taps 'I'm in', no app needed.
StrollCall finds a meeting point that's fair by walking time,
so nobody's left waiting,
then plans the walk you'll share.
On the way, your walking buddy has your back.
Ask for a coffee stop, a shorter route,
or what's nearby.
For homebodies, busy students,
and friends who keep saying 'we should hang out.'
Scan the code and take your first walk today.
StrollCall.
